title: Additive monoidal transport of a finite free module
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be preadditive monoidal categories with finite biproducts, and with tensor additive in each variable [def-weil-preadditive-category]. Let $P:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be additive [def-weil-pbc-additive-functor] and strong monoidal. Let $R$ be a commutative ring object, let $M$ be an internal $R$-module, and let $n\geq0$. Use the transported ring $P(R)$ and transported module $P(M)$ of [def-sfb-modobj-transport]. If $\theta:R^{\oplus n}\xrightarrow{\sim}M$ is an $R$-module isomorphism, there is a $P(R)$-module isomorphism
$$P(R)^{\oplus n}\xrightarrow{\sim}P(M).$$
Its $i$th inclusion is $P(\theta\iota_i)$ and its $i$th inverse coordinate is $P(\pi_i\theta^{-1})$, where the finite powers have the componentwise regular-module action. Thus the transported coordinate and basis maps satisfy the same Kronecker and sum-of-projections identities as the original maps.
